data.long_meaning: The name Leola is derived from the Greek word 'leos' meaning 'lion' and 'ola' meaning 'little shepherdess'. This name was often given to girls in ancient Greece who were believed to have the strength and courage of a lion and the nurturing and protective qualities of a shepherdess.
